messages:
Maya Chen: Planning a microtest for trial nudges: technical vs product-led subject lines, and a routing test that sends high-engagers to SDR queue. Short sync.
Ravi Patel: I'll build the segmentation: trial_0_2, trial_3_7, trial_8_30. Add flags: high_engage (clicked docs), low_engage (no opens).
Priya Desai: I'll own the SDR routing spec. If clicked >1 link and last_active <48h -> tag as priority and webhook to /sdr/high.
Tom Nguyen: Deliverability: run ISP sample 500, plus internal seeds. Canary 3% then 30% then 100%. Set threshold: hard_bounce>0.5% or complaint_rate>0.05% in first 30m.
Lena Kowalski: Copy variants: TECH: "Deep dive: optimize inference latency" vs PLG: "Get started: ship a simple prompt in 5 minutes". Footer to include webinar CTA with RSVP link.
Maya Chen: A/B plan: subject line across trial_0_2 only. We'll pick winner and apply to broader cohort after 24h.
Ravi Patel: Export will include timezone, last_event_ts, email_score. Suppress unsubscribed, bounced_90d, support_open. UTM: utm_campaign=trial_nudge_may
Priya Desai: Routing snippet for ops team: POST /webhook/sdr with payload {email, cohort, click_count, last_click_ts, utm_source}. Tom will coordinate auth.
ops-bot: pre-send checks scheduled at 2029-05-14T15:30:00Z; alert created: hard_bounce>0.005, complaint_rate>0.0005
Tom Nguyen: I'll monitor first 45m and escalate to infra if delivery_delay_median > 400s. Pager on for this thread.
Maya Chen: Owners recap: Segs=Ravi, Routing=Priya, Deliverability=Tom, Copy=Lena. Final QA tomorrow 9:30am PT. Publish playbook after QA.
Lena Kowalski: Locking copy now. Will add localized webinar times for APAC sends.
Ravi Patel: CSV snapshot will be posted once export finishes.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — small, fast test. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
